items.title: Eddie Bert interviewed by Monk Rowe, Danbury, Connecticut, November 20, 2001
items.q: You know, with Wardell Gray and them. Because they were right in the same place... Wardell was great.

ctx.x: You know, with Wardell Gray and them. Because they were right in the same place, you know, Nola’s. But you know Junior Collins that played with the Nonet? French horn?
